answer:
| Feature | Chiral Molecules | Achiral Molecules |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Definition** | Molecules that are not superimposable on their mirror images. | Molecules that are superimposable on their mirror images. |
| **Symmetry** | Lacks a plane, center, or alternating axis of symmetry ($S_n$). | Possesses a plane of symmetry ($\sigma$) or center of symmetry ($i$). |
| **Optical Activity** | Optically active (rotates plane-polarized light). | Optically inactive (does not rotate plane-polarized light). |
proTip: Remember that the absence of a plane of symmetry is the quickest way to identify a chiral carbon center in exams.
